summary.text: Joseph Fox is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives, first elected in November 2022, representing District 101, which includes all of Newaygo and parts of Oceana, Lake, Mason and Wexford counties.
He serves as vice chair of the House Election Integrity Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fox is from Brooklyn, Michigan, and his education includes a Master of Divinity from Calvin Seminary, a master's degree in counseling psychology from Western Michigan University and a bachelor's degree in philosophy/religion and psychology from Spring Arbor College.
He has been director of the Newaygo County Commission on Aging for seven years, a Christian school teacher and principal for 25 years, and a church planter and missionary for seven years.
He also serves on the House Education and Workforce, Agriculture, and Families and Veterans committees.
He lives in Fremont and has four adult children and 12 grandchildren.
